scored_papers.title: Squeezed-slit Bohr-Einstein Interferometer
scored_papers.abstract: The Einstein-Bohr recoiling-slit gedankenexperiment, a cornerstone of quantum complementarity, has long been constrained by the zero-point fluctuations of the atomic slit -- the spatial Standard Quantum Limit (SQL). Here we transcend this fundamental boundary through active quantum state engineering of a single-atom slit. By implementing a non-adiabatic quench-evolve-quench protocol, we prepare the atomic motion in a squeezed state, dynamically redistributing phase-space uncertainty to suppress which-path information and restore high-visibility interference beyond the static vacuum limit. We report an intrinsic visibility of $0.938_{-0.008}^{+0.004}$, violating the SQL ($0.819$) by over 10 standard deviations, corresponding to $7.6(2)$ dB of effective squeezing. Our work reveals Kerr-induced non-Gaussian dynamics and reinterprets the traditional interferometer as a powerful tool for continuous-variable Wigner tomography, bridging the gap between quantum foundations and advanced metrology.
scored_papers.reason: 🎯 Bohr-Einstein 思考実験を atomic slit の squeezed state で SQL 超え、wave-packet × 相補性の核心に直撃 ✨
scored_papers.summary: 単原子 slit を非断熱 quench で squeezed 化、phase-space 不確定性を再配分し which-path 抑制、SQL を 10σ 越え visibility 0.938 (7.6 dB) 🎉

scored_papers.title: Quantum Speed Limit under Calibration Uncertainty
scored_papers.abstract: Standard quantum speed limits presuppose exactly known parameters, overestimating operational speed under calibration uncertainty. We introduce a projected speed limit based on the quantum Fisher information that profiles out these nuisance parameters on a quotient manifold. We derive constructive bounds for general Markovian evolution using sensitivity equations. Applying this to Jaynes--Cummings sensors, we obtain explicit detuning tolerances and quantify speed limits arising from field-dependent Purcell loss. This framework turns geometric bounds into concrete design rules for calibration and interrogation time.
scored_papers.reason: 🎯 calibration uncertainty 込みの QSL、nuisance を quotient manifold で profile out する設計 ✨
scored_papers.summary: QFI ベースの projected speed limit を quotient manifold 上で構築、JC sensor で detuning tolerance と Purcell loss 速度限界を評価 ✨
